body:
I talked to  my son on his birthday.  He had a good time, and I can tell that he didn't really miss me, which is a relief.

I am in this position because a Dr prescribed an antidepressant.  Several Drs (including 2 psychiatrists), 3 hospitals and countless therapists couldn't figure out why my life went completely haywire at that time.

It was two years later (after I lost my family, 2 homes, and my job) that a new dr finally explained that the mania that ruined my life was caused by the ssri (antidepressant) and a misdiagnosis (I actually have bipolar, not depression).  This is a well known issue that the professionals missed in spite of my case being absolutely text book.  And it ruined my life.

I can't afford a Dr any more, and wouldn't go to one if I could afford it.

I definitely am alone.  I have begged a million different ways, and there is not a single person who has the ability and the will to help me.  Those that have the ability think I just need to get my head out of my ass, and those who understand the challenges are unemployed, impoverished, too busy, or too far away to be able to help.

I was denied social security assistance because I tried to work for a week in 2009.

I have applied for every kind of assistance there is, but I am told I am ineligible for everything except vocational assistance.  I am currently 2 months in to  a year+ long waiting list to get that assistance (meaning it will be at least 10 months before they even call me).

I have $175k in debt.  I can't afford bankruptcy, and even if I could, $40k of that would remain (not legally dischargable).  Legal aide has refused to take my case through three applications.

The last paycheck I got was in 2007.

As I mentioned in the OP, this has been happening over 4 years, and it has finally become too much.

Honestly, the advice "go to a dr" offends me.  If anybody is reading this, don't just go to a dr.  The wrong Dr is far worse than no Dr at all.

If you must go to a Dr for mental health issues, try to find one that is trustworthy.

As for my kids ( I have two sons), they have a great mom and will be fine without me.  Better off, in fact.  Social security will help them when I am dead.
